copy.tagline: Draw, guess, laugh at your friends.
copy.description: Everyone takes a turn drawing a word while the others try to guess it. Play with a crowd around one screen or type guesses in an online room; early guesses score more, and the artist gets a share of every correct one.
controls: On your turn, peek at the word in secret, then draw with a finger or the mouse.
Colour, brush size, undo and clear sit below the canvas.
Online, type your guess; only you see your wrong guesses.
On a shared screen, guesses are said out loud and the artist marks who got it first.

text.memorise: Remember it; it stays hidden while you draw.
text.drawingLocal: {name} is drawing. Shout out your guesses.
text.drawerHint: Correct guesses show up on the scoreboard. No letters or words on the canvas.
text.youGuessed: You got it! The word was {word}
